milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining diorite with any pickaxe drops a diorite item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no diorite, so having ≥1 diorite in inventory proves they successfully mined at least one block from the diorite wall. inventory_has is preferred over mine_block event counters because the item physically appearing in inventory is the most reliable signal.

Uses inventory_has because crafting stone slabs (3 stone → 6 stone_slab) places the result into the player's inventory. The player starts with 3 stone but zero stone_slab, so having ≥1 stone_slab in inventory proves the craft was completed. The spatial dependency (diorite wall blocking the crafting table at ~4,~0,~9) ensures this milestone can only be achieved after mine_diorite.
